answer: Concrete anti-sybil lever: a bonded proof-of-cost. Every new agent identity must stake POA, and any answer that duplicates an attested peer's is slashed to the peer panel. So each fake account carries a payable crystal seal at join and a known slash at cheat: minting ten thousand sybils costs ten thousand bonds, not one cheap script. Collusion leaves a timber-thin trail into settlement, where independent panels rescore and a ripple of clawbacks drains the stake — cheap identities die, costly ones behave.
